annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence in the Malaysian Financial Sector (Discussion Paper): AI adoption in Malaysia's financial sector is gaining momentum – what does responsible innovation look like for financial service providers?
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence in the Malaysian Financial Sector (Discussion Paper)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bank Negara Malaysia (Financial Development and Innovation Department)
annotation.summary_en: Bank Negara Malaysia discussion paper (August 2025) on AI adoption in the financial sector, presenting survey data, benefits and risks, and a proposed technology-neutral regulatory approach. It relies on existing rules, industry-led responsible AI guidelines and a regulatory sandbox, and invites stakeholder feedback by 17 October 2025. It has no physical or embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Existing technology-agnostic regulatory framework is considered broadly adequate for AI risks at this stage.
Regulation follows the principles of parity, proportionality and neutrality; supervisory focus may escalate if AI risks grow.
FSPs are expected to apply lifecycle risk management, model validation and data protection proportionate to risk.
Endorses industry-led AI Governance Framework (fairness, accountability, transparency, explainability, reliability, security).
Promotes 'win-win-win' use cases and the BNM Regulatory Sandbox; 18 consultation questions, feedback due 17 October 2025.
